gameplay.building_operations: Building systems and equipment have operational state, condition, redundancy and inspection schedules.
gameplay.business_occupancy: Business utility responsibility follows current unit occupancy and lease links.
gameplay.finance_boundary: No bills, payments, balances, rent, taxes or accounting entries are generated; BP-34 owns all financial postings.
gameplay.population: No residents, employees, customers or other person records are generated.
gameplay.simulation_time: All service and equipment records begin at simulation tick zero; future outages, readings and repairs are runtime events.
gameplay.utilities: Property connections, accounts, master meters and unit submeters are explicit and linked.
